items.text: Adults 21 and over may possess and carry up to 1 ounce (about 28 g) of cannabis and give up to 1 ounce to another adult; buying is from licensed retail stores only. Using it in any public place is illegal and is a violation with a fine of up to US$100 (about A$142 at A$1 = US$0.7040, RBA 30 Oct 2026).

Local option: Alaska law (AS 04.11.491) lets a community vote to ban the sale of alcohol, the sale and importation of alcohol, or the sale, importation and possession of alcohol. More than 100 mostly rural communities have held these votes. In a community that bans importation, nobody may bring alcohol in; where possession is banned, having any alcohol there is an offence (sacramental wine excepted), with a fine of up to US$1,000 (about A$1,420). Some damp communities (sales banned) need a local permit to buy or possess. Check the Alcoholic Beverage Control Board's current list before carrying alcohol to a rural town or village, including by small plane or boat.

laws.rule: It is a crime in Alaska to drive while reading or typing a text, communicating on a computer, or with a screen device operating in the driver's view (AS 28.35.161). Causing a death this way is a class A felony.

Non-residents 16 and over need an Alaska sport fishing licence to fish in fresh or salt water, and anyone fishing for king salmon (catch-and-release included) also needs a current king salmon stamp. Non-residents under 16 need no licence but may need a free harvest record card. Licences and stamps are sold by the Alaska Department of Fish and Game online, in its app and through vendors.
laws.penalty_signal: 2026 non-resident king salmon stamps range from US$15 for 1 day to US$100 for a year (about A$21 to A$142 at A$1 = US$0.7040, RBA 30 Oct 2026)

layers.authority: Alaska Department of Fish and Game, McNeil River State Game Sanctuary
layers.process: Access to the sanctuary needs an ADF&G access permit (AS 16.20.162). Viewing permits are limited to 10 people at the falls or other viewing places between 7 June and 25 August. For 2026 commercial transport continues by floatplane. Application dates and fees are on the permit pages, which did not state them when checked.

layers.authority: US National Park Service, Denali National Park
layers.process: Free backcountry permit required for every overnight trip. Mid-May to late September issued in person at the Backcountry Information Center, up to one day before or on the start day; other seasons at the Winter Visitor Center. 87 units, each with a nightly limit; every party member attends an orientation. Phone 907-683-9590. A road lottery was not found on the pages checked.
